vertebrae.extractors.sentence_transformers
==========================================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.extractors.sentence_transformers

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Optional sentence-transformers extractor.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.extractors.sentence_transformers.SentenceTransformerExtractor


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: SentenceTransformerExtractor(name, model_id, batch_size = 64, normalize_embeddings = True, device = None, show_progress_bar = False, model_kwargs = None, encode_kwargs = None)

   Sentence-transformers embedding extractor.

   :param name: User-facing extractor name.
   :param model_id: Sentence-transformers model identifier or local path.
   :param batch_size: Batch size passed to `model.encode`.
   :param normalize_embeddings: Whether sentence-transformers should normalize outputs.
   :param device: Optional device string.
   :param show_progress_bar: Whether to show sentence-transformers progress output.
   :param model_kwargs: Extra keyword arguments for `SentenceTransformer`.
   :param encode_kwargs: Extra keyword arguments for `model.encode`.


   .. py:method:: fit(X, y = None)

      No-op fit for frozen sentence-transformers models.

      :param X: Input text samples.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: This extractor.



   .. py:method:: transform(X)

      Encode text inputs into dense embeddings.

      :param X: Sequence of strings.

      :returns: Dense numeric embedding matrix.

      :raises ImportError: If sentence-transformers is not installed.
      :raises ValueError: If inputs are not strings or output is invalid.



   .. py:method:: fit_transform(X, y = None)

      Encode text inputs into dense embeddings.

      :param X: Sequence of strings.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: Dense numeric embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: recipe()

      Return a serializable sentence-transformers recipe.

      :returns: JSON-compatible recipe dictionary.
